integrity: The algebraic derivation is self-contained. Its mass-deficit envelope is saturated for every nonnegative center/horizontal/vertical mass triple. Exact rational identities and finite numerical checks are corroboration; no computational exhaustion over all complex coefficients is asserted. There is no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The sharp theorem assumes a five-point radius-one cross with nonaliased pair-difference geometry: the continuous two-torus or square cyclic grids of order at least five. Nothing is asserted at orders two through four, for arbitrary five-point frequency sets, or for higher even moments. The quadratic stability bound measures the central mass and axis imbalance but not all individual phase errors. Novelty is best-knowledge rather than independently established.
title: Sharp fourth Fourier moment and phase rigidity of the five-frequency cross
